findings.topic: Route fallback when no heat-free route exists
findings.evidence: Seed 1716643869: all four losses were 4x8 with zero bullet hits and four heat hits. Offline planner probes returned no heat-free final-safe route even at t=0; normal return activated around t=88.
findings.hypothesis: A planner failure is treated as no early escape needed. Assess the least-damage route earlier when heat is unavoidable; verify with controlled replay before adopting.

findings.topic: Protect a late lead and break repeated hits
findings.evidence: Camper 1782557660 inverted: 8x6 at t=112, first received hit at 114.767, lost 3x5. Dijkstra 1851487980 normal: 8x7 through t=108, repeated hits at essentially the same position, lost 2x7.
findings.hypothesis: Test a safe late-game lead policy and an escape response to repeated hits. Avoid sacrificing safe-zone access or attack when behind.

findings.evidence: Markov 1561892226 inverted: one hit received at 26.467, 89 shots and zero hits dealt, lost 7x8. Markov 1681820021 normal: 83 shots, zero hits either side, draw 8x8.
findings.hypothesis: Stalemate logic already exists; review its chosen angle and posture when it yields no hits, rather than merely increasing trigger frequency.

next_validation: Any future candidate must preserve the committed version and be compared on the same seeds plus unseen maps, against all bots and specialists.
